name: smartui-web-nodejs
description: LambdaTest SmartUI visual regression sample for a web application, covering Chrome, Edge, Firefox, WebKit/Safari desktop browsers plus real Android and iOS mobile browsers, across multiple resolutions.

scripts.test:desktop: cross-env SUITE=desktop smartui -c .smartui.json exec -- mocha test/*.test.js --timeout 180000 --exit
scripts.test:mobile: cross-env SUITE=mobile smartui -c .smartui.json exec -- mocha test/*.test.js --timeout 180000 --exit
